corrections.old_text: ህ በኋላ በቒ በዪኝ አላት የ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ህ በኋላ በሺ በዪኝ አላት የ↵
corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the top horizontal bar of ሸ (ሺ), forming the idiomatic Amharic phrase 'በሺ በዪኝ' (consent to me / say yes to me), misread as 'በቒ'.
Both visually and contextually the word is 'ይህንን' ('ይህንን ተውኝ' - let me off on this / spare me this), with 6th-order ህ and ን misread as 2nd-order ሁ and ኑ.
Canonical Ge'ez preposition/conjunction is 'ወእምከመ' (with 6th-order እ, not 1st-order አ), clearly visible in the print.
The printed glyph has the right-side hook of 6th-order ው ('ውሀ'), misread as 1st-order ወ.
Canonical Ge'ez lemma citation is 'ወእምከመ' with 6th-order እ, misread as 1st-order አ.
